_notes: Hand checked camp data for the summer camp week planner. Every camp carries the page its facts came from and the date read. 'weeks' are the Mondays the camp runs, in 'weeks_year'; 2026 weeks are shown on the 2027 grid as the same week of summer (plus 364 days) and marked as last year's schedule until the camp posts 2027. price_week is the full day, non member or non resident price, used only for the season estimate. Research sheet: camps/ in the main checkout (not tracked).
